_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The bookmarklet opens a linked chat about the page. The test itself answers Shelley's uploads and message sends (already in place; steps must not stub anything): call "uploads" lists the files uploaded, with the recording's audio file as AUDIO ("none" before any); call "sent" counts the messages sent and how the first starts; call "review" summarizes the review log uploaded with AUDIO. The test opens Shelley from the bookmarklet as a user would: it takes the bookmarklet from Shelley, then clicks it on a page on another origin, http://host.test/ (title "Host Page", a main with an h1 "Host Page", a paragraph #para "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog." and a list ul.list of "First item" and "Second item"), with that paragraph selected. The bookmarklet adds a toolbar to the host page, the element "shelley-bookmarklet", whose controls are in its open shadow root: a status span ".status" and the buttons Record, Pick, Shelley and Close. It opens Shelley in a popup, tab "popup", "the Shelley window". "The toolbar status" is the ".status" element in the toolbar: {"within": {"selector": "shelley-bookmarklet"}, "selector": ".status"} (selectors reach into open shadow roots, but a combinator like "shelley-bookmarklet .status" does not cross into one). Pick the toolbar's buttons by role "button" and exact accessible name, also with "within" the toolbar. Opening it: 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Click the button whose accessible name contains "More options". 3. The overflow menu's bookmarklet item is the bookmarklet too: keep its link, which must be a javascript: URL, with eval (window.__href = document.querySelector('[data-testid=bookmarklet-menu-item]')?.getAttribute('href') ?? '').startsWith('javascript:') expecting true. 4. Click [data-testid="bookmarklet-menu-item"], which opens a dialog with the bookmarklet to drag. 5. That dialog's link has the same href: eval document.querySelector('[data-testid=bookmarklet-link]')?.getAttribute('href') === window.__href expecting true. Then hand the link to the host page with eval fetch('http://host.test/bookmarklet', { method: 'POST', body: window.__href }).then((r) => r.ok) expecting true. Navigate tab "host" to http://host.test/. In tab "host", select the paragraph: eval getSelection().selectAllChildren(document.getElementById('para')). In tab "host", click the bookmarklet as if in the bookmarks bar: eval fetch('/bookmarklet').then((r) => r.text()).then((href) => { location.href = href; }). In tab "host", the toolbar status should be visible with exactly the text "Linked". Then perform these steps in order: 1. In the Shelley window, [data-testid="message-input"] must have the value exactly {{PAGE}}. 2. The Shelley window's URL must be exactly /new (assert_url value). 3. In the Shelley window, [data-testid="bookmarklet-status"] must have exactly the text "Linked to host.test". 4. Pick an element into the chat: in tab "host", click the toolbar's "Pick" button, then click the "ul.list li" with has_text "Second item". 5. In the Shelley window, the message input's value must be exactly {{PICKED_ITEM}}. 6. Call "uploads": it must return exactly "none". 7. Record from the page: in tab "host", click the toolbar's "Record" button; then in the Shelley window click the button whose accessible name is exactly "Allow" inside [data-testid="bookmarklet-ask"]. 8. In the Shelley window, ".recording-status" should have the attribute data-state exactly "recording". In tab "host", the toolbar status should have exactly the text "Recording page", and the toolbar's "Record" button must be disabled. In the Shelley window, [data-testid="bookmarklet-status"] must have exactly the text "Recording what you do on host.test". In tab "host", click #para. In the Shelley window, the page must hear of that click: eval window.__bookmarkletMessages.some((m) => m.event?.type === 'click') expecting true. In the Shelley window, click [data-testid="recording-stop-button"]. 9. In the Shelley window, there must then be exactly 0 [data-testid="recording-panel"] elements. 10. In tab "host", the toolbar status should have exactly the text "Linked", and the toolbar's "Record" button must be enabled. 11. In the Shelley window, [data-testid="bookmarklet-status"] must have exactly the text "Linked to host.test". 12. Call "uploads": it must return exactly "AUDIO, AUDIO.review.json". 13. Call "sent": it must return exactly "1 sent; the first starts /transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/AUDIO". 14. Call "review": it must return exactly "source=web-page url=http://host.test/ title=Host Page click-on-para=true stop-last=true times-in-range=true".

steps.text: Recording what you do on host.test

steps.expect: source=web-page url=http://host.test/ title=Host Page click-on-para=true stop-last=true times-in-range=true
